All services have returned to normal operation and are stable.

We have identified and paused the processes that contributed to the incident, and the platform has fully recovered. We will continue to monitor the environment closely to ensure stability.

A detailed postmortem, including root cause analysis, impact assessment, and follow-up actions, will be shared as soon as it is available.

d46qjfvqjk7j.body: Summary On 8 September 2026, between 10:11 and 10:59 CEST, we experienced an incident affecting our Templates and Share link APIs. During this window, users might have encountered errors when generating or acccessing page links. Full service was restored at 10:59 CEST. Root Cause A recent dependency upgrade introduced a compatibility issue between our API framework and an underlying observability library, which caused a few specific endpoints to fail once traffic passed a certain volume. Remediation We rolled back the affected deployment to immediately restore the service. We are applying a permanent fix to the underlying dependency issue before reintroducing the change. We apologise for any inconvenience this caused and thank you for your patience.
d46qjfvqjk7j.title: Templates and Share link API degradation

dh6ttn6wdyxw.body: We haven't observed any errors after our fix. The incident is resolved.
dh6ttn6wdyxw.title: Intermittent failures on Comparables

r2dbvlyvdbt5.body: Summary On 13 May 2025, between 10:30 and 11:05 CEST, we experienced an incident affecting our API services. The majority of users were unable to access the Valuation API during this window, and elevated response latency was observed across all API endpoints. Full service was restored at 11:05 CEST. Root Cause We identified a bottleneck in a component on the critical path of our infrastructure. Under load, this component became a limiting factor and degraded service availability and performance. Remediation We are actively implementing improvements to the affected component to increase its scalability and prevent recurrence. We will continue to monitor the situation closely following these changes. Monitoring & Transparency We are aware that this incident was not surfaced by the monitoring that feeds this status page, which means our customers did not receive a timely notification. We take this seriously. We are expanding our monitoring coverage and adding more granular detail to this status page to more accurately reflect the real-time health of our services. Our goal is to ensure that any future disruption is communicated proactively. We apologise for the disruption this caused and thank you for your patience.
r2dbvlyvdbt5.title: Valuation API Outage
